# Registry: skills

<!-- Generated by npm run registry from mcp/ and plugins/genobi/skills/. Do not edit; change the tool definition or the skill's frontmatter. -->

Each skill of the Genobi plugin: what it is for, the tools its instructions use and its docs. Agents load one with `genobi_skill`. Grouped by tag on [the registry](registry.md).

## `adaptive-reverb`

Make a version of Adaptive reverb, the first 3D + LTX mix template - the person says or types the room they want and which one it replaces ("a stone cellar instead of the hall"), an image being an optional reference, and the agent writes the first still's prompt, builds the room in World Builder, renders it with LTX-2.5 Layout-to-Render on the hosted deployment, processes the track with the room's CPU reverb and, in this v1, only labels it with a fixed AKUSPACE preset whose RT60 is the preset's, not a measurement (Acoustic Spaces v2 measures each room instead). Every paid step is quoted and waits for the person's yes.

- Tags: `agents`, `director`, `templates`, `world-builder`, `sound`, `ltx`
- Instructions: [plugins/genobi/skills/adaptive-reverb/SKILL.md](https://github.com/koshimazaki/Genobi/blob/main/plugins/genobi/skills/adaptive-reverb/SKILL.md)
- Uses: [`genobi_quote`](registry-tools.md#genobi_quote), [`genobi_submit`](registry-tools.md#genobi_submit), [`genobi_decision`](registry-tools.md#genobi_decision), [`genobi_skill`](registry-tools.md#genobi_skill)

## `fruits-swap`

Make a version of Dance with Fruits, the content-swap mix template - the person says or types what they want and what it replaces ("a mango instead of the apple"), an image being an optional reference, and the agent writes the prompt for the first still, builds the moving fruit in Three.js, renders the loop's window with LTX-2.5 Layout-to-Render on the hosted deployment and cuts it in on the beat. When the person asks for a change to the Genobi studio itself (its UI, a tool, a skill, a workflow, a node), start a Developer session with genobi_develop instead of telling them to open the repository - it works in a fresh worktree from origin/main, runs the checks, and leaves a diff or opens a pull request. ## `genobi-teaser`

Repeat or change the Genobi teaser, the two-minute mix of the studio in use cut to the owner's track - record the studio footage by replaying the scripted takes, edit the cut as data (shots, camera moves, callouts, Paper Shaders, the taste layer), render it with the Director's Render MP4, and record every correction as project memory. Nothing is generated or paid for.

## `genobi-teaser-run`

Recreate the Genobi teaser end to end as a reproducible run - analyse the track, derive every shot and overlay from the brief's storyboard, the analysis and the capture log with the decision rules, keep every on-screen word to the claim rules, write and verify the cut JSON, render it, review the contact sheet and save memory - then repeat it from the first run's memory alone. Written for a weaker open model (Hermes on DeepSeek). Nothing is generated or paid for.

- Tags: `agents`, `director`, `sound`, `verification`
- Instructions: [plugins/genobi/skills/genobi-teaser-run/SKILL.md](https://github.com/koshimazaki/Genobi/blob/main/plugins/genobi/skills/genobi-teaser-run/SKILL.md)

## `genobi-upscale`

Upscale a video in Genobi from start to finish - inspect the clip, choose SeedVR2 (open, free on a local GPU) or FLUX Video Upscale (API), run one upscale up to 20 s or plan a longer clip in 19 s parts behind one combined quote and one approval, wait while the parts are upscaled and joined with the clip's own sound, then report the joined clip and every part's state. Never resends an uncertain part.
